---

## 1. Current Default Pagination Value

**`50`** — but only as an **uncommitted local change**. The last committed value is **`10`**.

### Evidence

`src/app/dashboard/[propertyId]/auditing/page.tsx` line 51:
```ts
const pageSize = parsedPageSize && parsedPageSize > 0 ? parsedPageSize : 50
```


## 2. All Pagination Definition Points (Auditing Module)

| Location | File | Line | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Server page default** | `src/app/dashboard/[propertyId]/auditing/page.tsx` | 51 | Falls back to `50` (uncommitted) / `10` (committed) when `?pageSize=` is missing or invalid |

| **Table component** | `src/components/dashboard/auditing/auditing-table.tsx` | 25, 35 | Receives `pageSize` as a prop; uses it for `totalPages`, `startIndex`, `endIndex` math |
